text_block_list.text: (Jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Since it's a special occasion,
I'd love to go somewhere for Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yes. When it comes to Christmas,
it has to be...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A countryside fishing village!

I thought it would be a slightly fancier place, but I was wrong.
And so, transferring between buses, I arrived at a fishing village in snow country.
(Crunch, crunch, crunch...)
(Daaaze...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is it, right here...
This is the kind of thing I've always dreamed of...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Snow blowing against the window, a fishing port in the distance,
and the faint sound of a steam whistle...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is the true spirit of enka.
Ahh, it's just the best...
choice_data_list: Doesn't it feel a bit lonely?
Don't you feel a bit lonely?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Lonely...? Hmm, well, if nobody were around, maybe I'd feel lonely, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're with me, Trainer, I'm fine!
If you're letting me spend Christmas how I want, I'd prefer a quiet one like this!
Normally lively and boisterous, Kitasan Black turned out to have surprisingly mature, understated tastes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Trainer, would you like
something to drink? I'll pour it for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll have a drink too.
Let's see... some lukewarm sake, please...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I actually prefer cider a bit lukewarm,
rather than ice-cold.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I actually prefer it when the carbonation is fading.
I like it when it's flat and kind of slick.

"...What a surprise. It's not alcohol, but cider.
And she seems to drink it like quite the connoisseur."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
In my mood today, rather than cake, I'd prefer
something like soy-marinated squid or itawasa kamaboko.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And so, Merry Christmas,
Trainer-san! Let's take our time
and sip on drinks today!

Making a toast while watching the snow.
In its own way, it made for a wonderfully charming Christmas.
As we continued reminiscing and sharing drinks for a while...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's so nice... spending time like this...
Maybe this really is all we ever needed.
choice_data_list: What do you mean, 'this is enough'?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it... usually it feels too luxurious,
or rather, there's just too much stuff around.”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When you strip everything else away,
what's truly necessary is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Good company, a little food and drink.
And every now and then, the distant sound of a steam whistle...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this much is just right.
Even just this makes me pretty happy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It really... strikes a chord...
I've always wanted to visit a place like this once."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so very much
for bringing me here.

All the tension leaving her shoulders,
Kitasan Black savored a quiet, wabi-sabi Christmas.
It was another side of the Generalissimo Helper that nobody knew about.
It was another side of the Generalissimo Helper that nobody knew about.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Old Fisherman
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan... Is Kita-chan around?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... It's the local fisherman.
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Old Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
We've got a Christmas tree set up for Kita-chan.
Won'tcha come take a look?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A Christmas tree?! Just for me?
Trainer...
choice_data_list: Ah, looks like we're being welcomed.
Ah, looks like we're being welcomed.

text_block_list.text:
That Kitasan Black was coming to visit.
That surely must have been
huge news for this village.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go see it!
It'd be a shame to waste their kind gesture!

Pulled along by the arm by Kitasan Black,
I arrived at the mountain trail entrance on the
outskirts of the village. And there—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Waaah, this tree...!

A single, magnificent fir tree—
towered high into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Old Fisherman
text_block_list.text: There ain't no fancy decorations or nothin'. I just tidied up the snow a little, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This much is just right!
It looks so natural...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"This is the best Christmas present ever,
Trainer-san."
choice_data_list: Yeah... Want to make a wish?
Yeah... Want to make a wish?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's do that. Together!
Kitasan Black claps her hands together with pure delight and says a prayer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —I swear. We will live with our heads held high, just like this tree.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's plain, I'll go straight forward!
I will pierce through even the thickest snow clouds!

It felt as if the fir tree and the snowy sky
had fully embraced Kitasan Black's
earnest, single-minded wish.
